claims: Dan Hurley is the head coach of the UConn Huskies men’s basketball team.
Dan Hurley led the UConn Huskies men’s basketball team to back-to-back NCAA championships in 2023 and 2024.
Dan Hurley arrived at UConn in 2018.
Dan Hurley currently leads UConn through the 2026 NCAA tournament.
Dan Hurley won back-to-back NCAA Division I National Championships in 2023 and 2024.
Before joining UConn, Dan Hurley coached at Wagner College.
Before joining UConn, Dan Hurley coached at Rhode Island.
As of early 2026, Dan Hurley has a 165-69 record over 7 seasons with the UConn Huskies.
Dan Hurley is leading the UConn Huskies in the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
Geno Auriemma is the head coach of the UConn Huskies women's basketball team.
Geno Auriemma has 12 NCAA Division I championships
